# Security Engineering

**For:** Security teams and CISOs looking for isolation, identity, secrets and audit design.

Defence in depth by architecture: isolation, least privilege, secret brokerage, cryptographic proofs and audit trails.

## Role glossary

### A

**Append-Only Ledger**  
A store where records are only ever added, never edited or deleted, so history can be replayed and audited.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [03 Competition & Prize Platform](../../projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md), [16 Expression Complexity Engine](../../projects/16-algorithmic-expression-complexity-engine/profile.md), [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](../../projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md), [21 Assisted Meal Delivery Platform](../../projects/21-nutritional-logistics-assisted-delivery-platform/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](../../projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md)  

**Audit Trail**  
A tamper-evident record of who did what and when, kept so decisions can be reviewed by regulators, funders or operators.  
*Projects:* [03 Competition & Prize Platform](../../projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md), [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](../../projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md), [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](../../projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md), [21 Assisted Meal Delivery Platform](../../projects/21-nutritional-logistics-assisted-delivery-platform/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](../../projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md)  

### C

**Copy-on-Write (CoW) Snapshots**  
Filesystem snapshots (here ZFS) that share unchanged blocks, so a fresh sandbox can be cloned in seconds and thrown away cleanly.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  

### D

**Data Sovereignty**  
Keeping control of where data and code live and who can reach them, enforced by architecture (self-hosting, isolation, mirrors) rather than by vendor policy.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [19 Git Mirror Automation](../../projects/19-sovereign-git-continuous-mirror-automation/profile.md), [22 Social Enterprise Portal](../../projects/22-non-profit-community-social-enterprise-portal/profile.md), [26 Portfolio Engine](../../projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  

**DEFCON 0 (Zero-Egress Containment)**  
This portfolio's name for a sandbox whose outbound internet access is dropped at the host firewall by default and only allowed through named, isolated tunnels.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md), [26 Portfolio Engine](../../projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md)  

**Defence in Depth**  
Layering independent controls (network, kernel, identity, application, audit) so one failure does not expose the whole system.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](../../projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md)  

**Distributed Key Generation (DKG)**  
Creating a cryptographic key in pieces across parties so no single party ever holds the whole private key.  
*Projects:* [14 Web3 Notary Gateway](../../projects/14-decentralized-notary-web3-auth-gateway/profile.md)  

**Dual-Database Isolation**  
Keeping credentials and audit data in a separate database from day-to-day business data, so routine backups and access never touch secrets.  
*Projects:* [08 Workforce Scheduling Engine](../../projects/08-enterprise-workforce-scheduling-engine/profile.md)  

### H

**Hazard Filtering**  
The redaction process used to build this portfolio: extracting the architecture of private work while stripping client identifiers and proprietary detail.  
*Projects:* [26 Portfolio Engine](../../projects/26-principal-systems-engineering-portfolio/profile.md)  

**Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)**  
Automation that proposes actions but waits for an explicit human approval before high-impact changes are made.  
*Projects:* [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  

### L

**LXD System Containers**  
Containers that run a full Linux userland like a lightweight VM. Run unprivileged, they are the main isolation unit across these projects.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [20 LXD Clustering Toolkit](../../projects/20-automated-lxd-clustering-provisioning-toolkit/profile.md), [01 Event-Sourcing Operations Hub](../../projects/01-event-sourcing-operations-hub/profile.md)  

### M

**Merkle Tree**  
A tree of hashes that lets many documents be proven with one root hash, so batches can be anchored on-chain cheaply.  
*Projects:* [14 Web3 Notary Gateway](../../projects/14-decentralized-notary-web3-auth-gateway/profile.md)  

**Multi-Tenancy**  
Serving many customers from one platform while keeping their data separate, here by schema, host or organisational scope.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [04 Capacity Modeling Engine](../../projects/04-cognitive-capacity-modeling-engine/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [12 Consultancy Routing Portal](../../projects/12-unified-multi-tenant-consultancy-routing-portal/profile.md)  

### N

**Network Namespace Egress**  
Forcing a workload's outbound traffic through a dedicated network namespace and tunnel (WireGuard, Tailscale) so it never touches the host's WAN address.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md)  

### O

**OIDC Single Sign-On**  
Central identity (here Authentik) that every internal service trusts, instead of each keeping its own passwords.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  

### R

**RCON (Remote Console)**  
A game-server administration protocol, kept off the public internet here behind an authenticated web bridge.  
*Projects:* [18 Game Server RCON Orchestrator](../../projects/18-dedicated-game-server-rcon-orchestrator/profile.md)  

**Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**  
Granting permissions to roles rather than individuals, scoped per tenant or domain (Casbin in OASIS).  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md), [04 Capacity Modeling Engine](../../projects/04-cognitive-capacity-modeling-engine/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  

### S

**Schema-per-Tenant Isolation**  
Giving each customer their own PostgreSQL schema and selecting it per transaction, so a missed WHERE clause cannot leak another tenant's data.  
*Projects:* [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md)  

**Secret Brokerage (OpenBao)**  
Issuing short-lived credentials to workloads at runtime instead of storing keys on disk or in environment files.  
*Projects:* [06 AI Sandbox Control Plane](../../projects/06-autonomous-ai-sandbox-control-plane/profile.md), [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md)  

### V

**Verifiable Random Draw (PRNG)**  
Seeded pseudo-random selection with recorded inputs, so a prize draw can be proven fair after the fact.  
*Projects:* [03 Competition & Prize Platform](../../projects/03-competition-prize-gaming-platform/profile.md)  

### Z

**Zero-Trust Networking**  
Treating every request as untrusted until identity is verified, regardless of which network it comes from.  
*Projects:* [07 Sovereign LXD Cluster](../../projects/07-sovereign-hybrid-cloud-lxd-cluster/profile.md), [05 OASIS Multi-Tenant SaaS](../../projects/05-schema-isolated-multi-tenant-saas/profile.md)
